content: We need to determine number of methyl groups in the sample's molecule. We have no direct description of molecule. We can get NMR spectra to infer. Use proton NMR to see methyl signals (singlet, doublet, etc). Could also use carbon NMR to see CH3 carbons. Probably easiest: get proton NMR spectra via tool. Then count distinct methyl signals (CH3). But need to know number of methyl groups, not signals (could be overlapping). However typical approach: count number of CH3 peaks in 1H NMR. Use tool proton_nmr_spectra (no input needed? It says takes SMILES string? Actually function signature: proton_nmr_spectra = (_: {}) => any; no parameters. So it will return spectra for sample at hand (the unknown). Let's call it.
